errors.text_span: with the o_pop parameter implicitly held constant as per the caption
errors.evidence: The figure caption mentions 'with respect to s_pop and o_pop', which does not necessarily mean o_pop is held constant. It could mean the two lines represent different o_pop values. Stating it's held constant is an unsubstantiated interpretation.

errors.text_span: with tick marks at every integer interval
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are at intervals of 2 (1, 3, 5, 7, etc.), not at every integer.

errors.text_span: and then remains nearly constant at 1.0 from s_pop frequency 11 to 19
errors.evidence: The blue line is not constant from s_pop frequency 11 to 19. It is at approximately 0.99 at 11, dips to approximately 0.9 at 13, rises to 0.99 at 15, and only reaches 1.0 at 17 and 19.

errors.text_span: then declines to approximately 0.48 at s_pop frequency 13
errors.evidence: For the green line, at an s_pop frequency of 13, the accuracy value is approximately 0.6, not 0.48.

errors.text_span: rises again to approximately 0.99 at s_pop frequency 17
errors.evidence: The green line reaches an accuracy of exactly 1.0 at s_pop frequency 17, not 0.99.
The description does not mention that there is no legend to differentiate the two data series, an important feature noted in the reference description.
